decisions.title_en: Kimi K3 open weights go live at 00:00 UTC July 27 — largest open-weight model ever at 1.4TB
decisions.reason: Previously published 2026-07-20 ('太火了反而卖断货', about Kimi K3 pausing new subscriptions after launch).
